mission_summary: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.

target_users.Application Developers: Building LLM-powered applications with GUI interfaces

target_users.AI Agent Developers: Creating specialized agents for specific tasks

target_users.AI Agents: Claude, Gemini, Codex, and other AI models working with this codebase

core_value: Reliable, type-safe, and extensible foundation for GUI-LLM integration with predictable state management and clear component boundaries.
